recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5270 unless the Patient Administration work group later wants a broader HealthcareService examples refresh independent of this 2015 ballot comment.
issue_request: FHIR-5270 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration ballot comment saying HealthcareService was too generic and unclear, lacked usage guidance and meaningful examples, and should clarify whether it represented high-level advertised services or detailed schedulable acts. The accepted resolution was to add usage guidance/use cases and examples, while leaving the historical resource-page category outside Scheduling/Ordering.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit e7cc9ca4143c88e9853a8a78ce856d0175be9833, whose subject explicitly named Tracker# 5193, 5270, and 5192 and added HealthcareService Scope and Usage, common examples, example uses, and Boundaries and Relationships prose. The next-day HealthcareService example expansion in 8fb7336ca520b2fabc07796058cd9c9aa4ea19f3 also improved the previously thin example surface.
additional_context: HealthcareService remains active in the current build according to source/fhir.ini. Later source history refined rather than reversed the FHIR-5270 direction: FHIR-22687 added catalog/hierarchy language and CT scan examples, and FHIR-50073 updated the introduction to distinguish general categories such as Radiology from more specific schedulable services such as CT Scan while cleaning up potentially confusing examples. Quoted-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community record that conflicts with the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: An empty no-change audit commit was published. The current HealthcareService introduction explains what the resource is for, its granularity, virtual services, use with Organization/Location/Service and scheduling, common examples, and example uses. The current examples list and detailed HealthcareService/example also provide the example material the ballot comment said was missing.
